description_en: Enables or disables multiple blacklist policies at a time
description_zh: 调用EnableMetricRuleBlackList接口启用或禁用报警黑名单策略
kebab_example: aliyun cms enable-metric-rule-black-list --id a9ad2ac2-3ed9-11ed-b878-0242ac120000 --is-enable true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableMetricRuleBlackList

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the blacklist policies. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 IDs.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a blacklist policy, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html.

You can also set this parameter to a JSON array. Example: `["a9ad2ac2-3ed9-11ed-b878-0242ac12****","5cb8a9a4-198f-4651-a353-f8b28788****"]`
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的ID。多个ID之间以半角逗号（,）分隔，且不能超过50个。

关于如何获取报警黑名单策略的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html。

该参数也支持JSON Array格式，例如：`["a9ad2ac2-3ed9-11ed-b878-0242ac12****","5cb8a9a4-198f-4651-a353-f8b28788****"]`
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the blacklist policy. Valid values:

true: The blacklist policy is enabled.

false (default): The blacklist policy is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用报警黑名单策略。取值：

true：启用。

false（默认值）：禁用
parameters.name: is_enable

Code.description_en:
The status code.

The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Count.description_en: The number of blacklist policies that are enabled or disabled
Count.description_zh: 成功启用或禁用的报警黑名单策略的数量

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
